content: Jesus Tiha Haxaotyakiraharenai Kiji

Hatyaoseta haki ferakenetehena hoka hisehaliti Páscoa ferakene tyaohena hoka Jesus kamanaose xane hikoa. Hoka Jesus atyo waiyoreta hakamanaose ferakene hikoane kakoa, exahe hahalakira halitinai hoka haxáneneheta hanexe nali kakoa. Awaiyetya haxaotyakiraharenai hakamane kijiya.
Makehena hoka Jesus kanakairita haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa. Exowaka Tihanare koxaka haxahekola moka Simão ityani Judas Iscariotes mahiyasako mátawatya maheta Jesus.
Jesus ana atyo waiyekehalakita Enexe tyotya xoalini hare xekohasehare mohenerene kakoa. Exahe waiyoreta tehitiya atyo tyohenere Enore nalita kakoa, exahe haxaneneheta Enore nali xeta kakoa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus tityoaheta hanakaira aoseta hoka aitoakisa haima ehaorete hoka iya tirihisoakalati taose hoka olatya hakitako hiye.
Hatyaoseta tinihaliti koa one moka hoka tihehena haxaotyakiraharenae kiji hoka tirityahaheta ikijiha tirihisoakalati kakoa.
Xane kaoka Simão Pedro haliya hoka Simão Pedro nehena ihiye: — Xoana, hatiha nokiji haokowi, Xekohaseti? nexa axa Jesus.
— Há, natihaite hikiji — nexa Jesus. — Kalikini natihehena hikiji hoka maisa waiyekehalakere homana. Hoka haxowakaite waiyekehalaka homana — nexa Jesus.
— Maisaiya hatihita nokiji, xoana hiyekohaseyatya natyo hoka? nexa Pedro ihiye. — Maisaiya natihita hikiji hoka maisaiya noxaotyakirihare naokita hiso — nexa Jesus.
Nexa Jesus hoka Pedro nexa ihiye: — Nikare atyo hoka hatihehena nokiji, nokahe, noseri hare, Xekohaseti — nexa.

— Xala xamani atyo koxaka koaha hoka iyoma tyaona hoka ikiji taita katihakehitiya hoka ehekore. Koxaka xityotya xikatihakere xisaonita, hatita taita atyo hekota maiyomenehare akereta tyaonita — nexa Jesus Pedro hiye.
Jesus atyo waiyoreta hamatawatyasehare kakoa hoka: — Hatita taita atyo hekota maiyomenehare akereta tyaonita — nexa iraeta.
Hatyaoseta Jesus tiha ikijinaiha, miyatya hoka xane isoaheta haima ehaorete ako hoka tyokehetehitiya enekoniha hoka nehena ihiyeha: — Xoana waiyekehalaka xomana natihehenere xikiji? nexa axahene.
— Xasemehena: xiso atyo, “Xaotyakisatiye, Xekohaseti”, xita nohiye xiraihena nokakoi hoka. Ehekoreta nikare xita, hatyo terota atyo natyo.
Xiyaiya, natyo xakore Xiyaotyakisase, Xiyekohase hoka natiha xikiji xomana. Maika nikare tehitiya xatiha kakoa xikijinai.
Xiyaiya, naimenekoita xomana hoka namokitere akereta xamoka maheta.
Waiye xasemehena: maisa wakahare haxekohase xahehare xini, exahe exaxikatyakahare hoka haxaxikatyasehare xahehare xini.
Exe akiti waiyekehalaka xomana hoka xisaonaiya exema hoka waiyeya xihalahareya xisaona — nexa Jesus irae haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa.

— Maisa atyo xityotya xiyaokaka xini niraeta. Haiyaharenai naohenere nomani kakoa atyo nawaiyoreta. Xakore hoka hatya atyoite nahalakoihare tyaona. Exe Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa kaxairatyakehenere akeretaite kawenatyaka:
— Kalikinita exehare niraeta nikare kawenatyakehenere nahitita hoka nikare kawenatyakehena hoka xityakekohena maheta natyo. Hiyaiya, natyo atyo natyota terota — nexa.
— Xasemehena niraini: Xala xamani waiye mokita noxaxikaliharenai hoka waiye mokita natyo. Nikare waiye mokita natyo hoka noxaxikatyasehare tehitiya waiye mokita — nexa Jesus ihiyeha.
Jesus Hotikisa Matawatyatiye
Jesus hatyo tahi irai hoka enajikinita amaikoharehena hoka nehena ihiyeha waiyekehalaka: — Aliterexe niraeta: hatyaite xinekonitare mátawahena natyo — nexa ihiyeha.
Nexa ihiyeha hoka exaotyakiraharenai wahakotyakakoaha. — Xala xaokaka nikare iraeta? nexa ahekotyaha.
Exowaka hatya tyokita Jesus haliya Jesus awaiyetititere.
Tyokita Jesus haliya hoka Simão Pedro aimenekokoatya enomana axa maheta Jesus.
Aimenekokoatya enomana hoka axehena Jesus: — Xalaite mátawahena hiso, Xekohaseti? nexa axa Jesus.

Axa Jesus hoka Jesus nexa: — Nakairatite namaika hoka nisa enomana. Hatyo atyoite nomatawatyasehare tyaohena — nexa hoka nakairati maika hoka isa Judas Iscariotes ana. Judas atyo Simão Iscariotes nexarexe ityani.
Isa enomana hoka Judas kanakaira hatyo nakairati hoka Ahalakoahaliti kamilakoretene. Hatyaoseta Jesus nexa ihiye: — Hiyanehena atyo hoka hisoma haokowitere hisomehena rotita — nexa.
Nexa Jesus irai ekakoa hoka nali tyokiterenai semene hoka maisa hatya ana hekoti waiyekehalakita.

Judas atyo enoloxaha kaxaikotyasehare tyaonita enomanaha hoka motya Jesus axikatene nakairati iya maheta hisehaliti niyahare aokahitaha. Haiyanai motya Jesus axikatene hoka isa maheta olo maxiyehareharenai ana aokahitaha.
Hoka Judas kanakaira hatyo nakairati isehenere enomana hoka xane rotita. Exowaka koxaka maka.
Waitare Xaotyakiyaho
Judas xaneheta enonyahitaha hoka Jesus nehena: — Kalikini Haliti Ityani kaxaexakerityaka, exahe Enore tehitiya hoka kaxaexakerityaka ihiyeta.
Enore kaxaexakerityaka ihiyeta hoka Enore hiyeta atyoite Haliti Ityani kaxaexakerityaka. Kalinite Enore nikare mohena — nexa Jesus.

— Exeta atyoite maisa waha notyaohitita xikakoa, nokaxaikoniharenai. Noxanihetaite xonita hoka xatawaite natyo hoka maisaite xikaokita natyo. Noxanihetehena hoka maisaiya xijoita noxanihenere nali. Koxaka noxakai hatyo akiti judeunai hiye.
Hoka kalikini exe iraiti waitare kakoa naotyakihitiya xiso. Maika xawaiyetyakakoa nawaiyetitere xiso akere xawaiyetyakakoa tehitiya.
Xawaiyetyakakoaiya hoka tyotya halitinai anaiya waiyekehalaka hoka, “Hatyonai atyo Jesus xema nawenatyaseharenai”, nexahaiya xiyaokaka — nexa Jesus.
Pedro Hiye Jesus Irae

Hatyaoseta Simão Pedro axehena Jesus: — Alyakoite hiyanehena, Xekohaseti? nexa axene. — Awisa noxanihena hoka maisaiya atyo kalikinita hiyaneta noxanihenere nali. Hoka haxowaka atyoite hisoa noximi — nexa Jesus.
— Xoana hoka maisa kalikinita notyoa hiyema haokita? Koxaka nomimiye notyaonita nokamani niyahare hikakoa — nexa Pedro irai.

— Xoana, alitere haokita? nexa Jesus. — Hasemehena niraini: Awisa takoira makawiraharenetaite hehena: “Exe haliti atyo maisa nowaiyanihare xini”, hexaite noxaokaki. Exakere ite hanamaki hirae — nexa Jesus Pedro niraine nahalakoa.
